title.value: Routine Bandits: Minimizing Regret on Recurring Problems
title.justification: The title is directly obtained from the header and repeated throughout the document.
title.quote: Routine Bandits: Minimizing Regret on Recurring Problems

analysis.description: The research introduces a variant of the multi-armed bandit problem, called routine bandits, where a learner faces recurring but unknown bandit instances. The paper develops the KLUCB-RB algorithm to minimize cumulative regret across periods by leveraging past observations. Theoretical and empirical analyses demonstrate the algorithm’s efficiency in reducing regret.

type.justification: The paper presents a new theoretical framework (routine bandits) and develops a new strategy (KLUCB-RB) with theoretical analysis and guarantees on regret.
type.quote: We provide a theoretical analysis of KLUCB-RB (Sec. 4) and investigate the performance of the algorithm using extensive numerical experiments (Sec. 5).

name.justification: The study revolves around the multi-armed bandit problem, a core topic in reinforcement learning.
